Harbour City Herald | Business | 7 October 2026 10:00 AEDT
Warm spring weekend lifts Sydney fashion sales

Sydney retailers enjoyed a strong long weekend as temperatures climbed to 28 degrees, with shoppers snapping up linen shirts, polos, swimwear and sandals.

Pitt Street Mall and the Castlereagh Street luxury strip were busy on Saturday and Monday. Store staff said winter clearance racks were largely ignored. "Nobody is looking at puffers in October here, it's all T-shirts and light jackets," said one.
